title: Expanded Sales by Customer and At Risk tables show the expected columns
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. You use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  3. You are in a location (workplace) that has invoices and technician clocked time over the last twelve months.

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 3: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. On the QA site try Staging Heavy Duty - 9919. Check: on the Dashboard, switch the Revenue and Technician Efficiency pills to Last 12 Months: both show figures; then set both back to This Month (the dashboard remembers your choices in this browser). If not, try the other locations in the list. If no location in the list passes this check, mark the case Blocked and write in the result comment that no location has this data.
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top menu and click View details on Sales by Customer (Last 12 Months).
  2. Read the table title, column headings and the pager under the table.
  3. Click the pager's next arrow.
  4. Click View details on At Risk Customers.
  5. Read the panel title, the control at its top right and the column headings.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Sales by Customer: a table titled "Sales by Customer" with columns Customer, Invoices, Labor Delta, Subtotal, ten rows a page and a pager such as "1 - 10 of 15". The next arrow shows the next ten. Customer names show as links.
  • At Risk Customers: a table titled "At Risk Customers" with columns Customer, Last Invoice Date, Lifetime Invoices, Revenue (12 Mo). There is no "Last Work (Days)" column, and an "Inactive for" window select (e.g. "120 Days") sits at the panel's top right.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9578 (Story 6, Expanding a Tile); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 6 (S6-R7, S6-R8). Column names, pager and the "Inactive for" select come from the design canvas boards 08_Customers_After and 09_AtRisk_After (rows 8 and 9, screenshots of build SV-8311 captured 2026-09-28), which replace the retired 'Dashboard Directions' design.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-R7: “The Sales by Customer tile expands to the Sales by Customer table.”
  • S6-R8: “The At Risk Customers tile expands to the At Risk Customers table. The table is ordered by each customer's trailing-twelve-month revenue, highest first, with the customer name as the tiebreaker, so the largest amount at risk reads first. The table lists every at-risk customer. A safety cap of 500 rows applies: if a workplace ever exceeds it, the table shows the first 500 in that order and says so on screen, reading "Showing 500 of N at-risk customers", while the headline still counts every one. The table never truncates silently, because a table that stops short while the headline counts more is a defect: the two then disagree.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
